tokenRefused: daemon token refused; the host holds the current one
firstFrameNotAuth: the first frame must be auth
preAuthBytesExceeded: too many bytes before the auth frame
authDeadlinePassed: no auth frame arrived in time
tokenRotated: the daemon token was rotated; dial again with the current one
noToken: daemon refuses to start without an auth token
portScopeRefusal: this socket is scoped to port {port}: only tunnel ops on it and ping are allowed
foldersOutside: {dir} is outside the folders wsp browses on that computer: {roots}
noImagesHere: this computer keeps no images: a workspace here is a copy of the computer itself
guestNotWatcher: only the socket that sent guest.watch may answer or close a guest session
guestQueueFull: the host has not read this session for too long
guestInFlightFull: too many guest bytes are waiting to be read here; send this one again
guestWorkspaceFull: this workspace already holds as many guest sessions as it may; end one and run it again
guestUnwatched: the host stopped watching; run it again
guestNoDaemon: this machine's wsp daemon is not answering on 127.0.0.1:{port}
placeKeptForLink: nothing was removed at {path}: a folder on the way to it is a link
onBase: this workspace is on {base}, the branch it started from; move the commits onto a branch of their own and bring back again
notOnABranch: this workspace is not on a branch, so there is nothing to bring back yet
nothingAhead: {branch} has no commits that {base} lacks, so there is nothing to bring back
noRemote: this project has no remote to push to
noHostCli: no signed-in command line for {host} is on this computer; the branch is pushed and the pull request waits for one
noGitCredential: this computer has no git credential for {host}, so nothing was pushed; {fix}, then bring back again
noGitCredentialNoFix: this computer has no git credential for {host}, so nothing was pushed
hostKeyRefusal: the host at {url} did not prove the key this computer learned at join; nothing was sent to it
noPlaceFile: no place file here, so there is no host to dial; wsp join <address> --code <code> makes this computer a place
hostQuiet: the host at {url} sent nothing for {seconds}s; cutting the link and dialling again
notAFrame: {url} sent something that is not a frame
authUnreadable: {url} answered place.auth with something this computer cannot read: {error}
linkOutOfOrder: {url} answered out of order; nothing was sent to it and the next address is tried
linkHostUnsealed: the host at {url} agreed no key for this link; it runs an older wsp
